title: Scholarship rules updated
summary: Some scholarship types have been increased and conditions for first-year students clarified.

body.text: Updated rules for scholarships and social support apply from 1 September 2026. Details are available in the Student Life section.
Applications are accepted at the faculties and the student affairs office.
